spans.s: --the thirtieth Kalpa; ब्रह्मा got a son red in colour, dress and eyes; finding him to be महादेव, ब्रह्मा bowed to him and contemplated upon वामदेव; शर्व appeared to him and made अट्टहास when were born four sons beginning with Viraja. वा. २२. २१-30.
--an Asura killed by दुर्गा. Br. IV. २९. ७६.
--one of the six charioteers of ललिता. Br. IV. २०. ९२.
(I)--a son of वसिष्ठ and ऊर्जा. Br. II. ११. ४१. [page३-042+ २७]
(II)--the son of खश: A fearful figure of three heads, three hands and three feet: roamed in the night in search of prey of men and animals. Br.
(III)--meaning पालन or protection from राक्षसस्. वा. ६९. १०१.

(IV)--resides in the sun's chariot during the month of शुची;
1: Vi. II. १०. 7.
फाल्गुन.
2: Ib. II. १०. १८.
(I)--the sister of ऋक्ष; wife of प्रजापति and mother of जाम्बवन्. Br.
(II)--the use of amulets to protect children and others from evils. Vi.

(II)--एत्य्: (see also यक्ष, निशाचर). When out of hunger the first created beings began to swallow water, the राक्षसस् tried to protect the waters; then the hairs of प्रजापति stood on end with anger; out of this came snakes of all sorts;
1: Br.
--one of २८ hells for the sin of पुरुषमेध. भा. V. २६. 7 and ३१.
--cited on the श्राद्ध day to keep off the राक्षसस्. Vi. III. १५. ३१.
--a son of अर्काग्नि. Br. II. १२. ४३; वा. २९. ४०.

(I)--a daughter of Angiras and स्म्र्ती; wife of धात्रि, and mother of प्रातस्;
1: भा.
(IV)--Two lavas of the afternoon of Pratipada. M. १३३. ३६; १४१. ३३, ४१, ५१. [page३-061+ ३७]
--a form of marriage by which कृष्ण married रुक्मिणी. But Rukmi objected to this form of marriage. भा. X. ५२. १८ and ४१; ५४. १८; Vi. III. १०. २४.
--eight in number: perhaps the seven daughters of खश and नीला; create fear and disease among children (human beings- वा। प्।). Br.
--when no ceremonies are to be performed; the first three मुहूर्तस् or नालिकस् of the morning, सङ्घव (8-३० to ११ A.M.) of noon, afternoon and evening. M. २२. ८२-83.
--a chief doorkeeper in Geyacakraratha. Br. IV. १९. ८८.
